checks: briefing cannot discover, answer, accrue time or XP
start is explicit and repeated start does not reset an attempt
unseen findings cannot be answered
unknown and prototype IDs are ignored
discovery alone earns only 20 percent of the finding weight
repeated discovery cannot farm points
invalid answer indices cannot count as attempts
safe first decision earns the full weight
completed findings reject both repeated right and wrong decisions
wrong first decision does not complete and deducts discovery credit
further wrong attempts are recorded without stacking the first-decision penalty
correcting a wrong first decision recovers 80 percent, not a perfect score
six first-time safe decisions normalize to exactly 100 and 200 local XP
six corrected first errors finish at 80 with six first-decision learning points
inspection order does not change normalized score
scoring is independent of completion speed and device
relative weights sum to 100 and prioritize high-consequence operations
real active-time deltas accumulate without frame-rate clamping
invalid time deltas are rejected
paused clock and inspection are frozen
resume continues the same findings and time
early finish lists missed risks and never awards free answers
finished attempts cannot resume, answer or extend the clock
cancellation is a frozen incomplete report, including from paused state
restart returns to briefing and resets score, XP, time and attempt history
state transitions do not mutate prior attempts
versioned summary is serializable without a persistent profile identity
